scopeConclusion: The TS storage refinement should be exactly “Yi hlayiseka, kumbe yi sala yi ri emavuni ku fikela loko u yi lava.” The matching in-module “yi hlayiseka” supports removing a. It preserves both alternatives and the until-needed boundary with no duration claim. All three young-leaves spans preserve young/leaf/possessive/edible/too and the exact sweet-potato referent. Retaining the English age phrase avoids an unsupported young→small/new shift. The mixed-language possessive/agreement should remain draft pending fluent checks, especially TS class concord. No repository edits.
